Commentary.Commentary: The tour has ended on a sad note with the last T20I getting abandoned due to unfit outfield conditions. It is a shame really as there was a huge enthusiastic crowd waiting for the game patiently but sometimes things don't turn out as they are supposed to be. The tour began with India dominating the proceedings. They took an unassailable 3-0 lead in the 5-match ODI series. Australia were good in patches but their batting collapses ruined their efforts. An explosive performance saw them defeating the No. 1 ranked side in the 4th match but they again faltered. It was looking gloomy for the visitors again but they showed good character, leveling the T20I series 1-1 in Guwahati, keeping their hopes alive. However, a damp squib in the decider today meant that the series ended unfortunately. It's time to bid you farewell. Do join us for future games. Wishing you all a very happy and prosperous Diwali in advance. Stay safe. Cheers!
